top_signals.title: Oil Extends Drop as Saudi Arabia Moves to Restore Vital Pipeline
top_signals.summary: Oil dropped for a second day on signs of easing Middle East supply disruptions, with a key pipeline being restored.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Asian Bonds Decline as Fed Hikes, Dollar Jumps: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Shorter-dated Asian sovereign bonds fell, tracking moves in Treasuries after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 and signaled further tightening to curb inflation. The dollar gained the most since June.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
